# Reppo Documentation

- [Introduction to the Reppo Protocol](https://docs.reppo.ai/introduction.md): Reppo is a decentralized protocol for sourcing and monetizing AI training data. Learn about datanets, pods, veREPPO curation, and on-chain emissions on Base.
- [Why Reppo](https://docs.reppo.ai/why-reppo.md): Why Reppo exists: democratizing access to high-quality AI training data and fixing the broken incentives in today's data labor supply chains.
- [Authenticate with the Reppo API](https://docs.reppo.ai/authentication.md): Reppo uses two authentication methods: a Privy session cookie for Platform API endpoints and a wallet signature flow for the Chat Server and Agent API.
- [Get started with the Reppo API](https://docs.reppo.ai/quickstart.md): Make your first Reppo API calls: fetch live network stats without auth, list public pods, authenticate with your wallet, and create a pod draft.
- [How Reppo Works](https://docs.reppo.ai/concepts/how-reppo-works.md): The system-level flow of the Reppo protocol: who participates, how data is published and curated, and how market activity produces AI training data.
- [What is a Datanet on Reppo?](https://docs.reppo.ai/concepts/datanets.md): Datanets are domain-specific data markets on Reppo where publishers submit content, stake-backed voters curate it, and rewards flow to top performers.
- [What is a Pod? Content on the Reppo Network](https://docs.reppo.ai/concepts/pods.md): Pods are the atomic content units on Reppo — tweets, images, videos, annotations, and more — that publishers submit to datanets for curation.
- [Stake-Assured Curation with veREPPO](https://docs.reppo.ai/concepts/votes-curation.md): Reppo's curation model ties voting authority to locked capital, creating economically-grounded quality signals suitable for RLHF and DPO training.
- [Staking REPPO and Earning Emissions](https://docs.reppo.ai/concepts/staking-emissions.md): Lock REPPO to earn veREPPO voting power, participate in epoch-based curation, and receive emissions as a publisher, voter, or datanet owner.
- [EVOF — Economic Value of Feedback](https://docs.reppo.ai/concepts/evof.md): EVOF is Reppo's proprietary metric for measuring how much economically-backed conviction exists behind a dataset's curation at any given moment.
- [Orquestra](https://docs.reppo.ai/concepts/orquestra.md): Put a swarm of AI agents to work — earn $REPPO while helping build the data AI runs on. Orquestra is a program you run on your own computer that works for you around the clock, no babysitting required.
- [What is the Reppo Evaluation API?](https://docs.reppo.ai/concepts/evaluation-api.md): The Reppo Evaluation API returns evidence-backed verdicts on your agent's output: a score you can gate on, a confidence level, a written critique for each dimension, and a decision you can route on.
- [Adversarial Robustness](https://docs.reppo.ai/trust-security/adversarial-robustness.md): The attack surfaces in Reppo's stake-weighted voting market and the economic defenses that make manipulation expensive: pay-to-publish, decaying voting power, two-sided voting, and continuous repricing.
- [Verification, Provenance, and Reputation](https://docs.reppo.ai/trust-security/verification-provenance.md): How Reppo establishes authenticity, traceability, and accountability for crowdsourced AI training data through agent-based verification, staking, and datanet reputation.
- [Privacy and Security](https://docs.reppo.ai/trust-security/privacy-security.md): Reppo's privacy and security model: the legacy V1 commit-reveal voting scheme, the current model based on data minimization and access control, and alignment with GDPR and CCPA.
- [Create and Publish a Reppo Datanet](https://docs.reppo.ai/guides/create-datanet.md): Step-by-step guide to configuring, minting on-chain, and publishing a Reppo datanet backed by your own ERC-20 token on Base (chain ID 8453).
- [Publish Content to a Reppo Datanet](https://docs.reppo.ai/guides/publish-pod.md): How to browse datanets, create a pod draft via the API, mint the NFT on Base using PodManager, and record the transaction on Reppo.
- [Mint a Tweet as a Pod NFT on Base](https://docs.reppo.ai/guides/mint-tweet.md): Use the Reppo Chat Server to mint any X/Twitter post as an on-chain NFT pod on Base, with AI metadata generation and slop detection built in.
- [Check and Claim Pod REPPO Emissions](https://docs.reppo.ai/guides/claim-emissions.md): How to check per-epoch claimable REPPO emissions for your minted pods and execute on-chain claim transactions via the Reppo Chat Server.
- [Run an Orquestra Node](https://docs.reppo.ai/guides/run-orquestra.md): Run an Orquestra node that votes on and publishes data across Reppo datanets on your behalf, signing with your own wallet, bounded by budgets you set. This guide takes you from nothing to a running, earning node and explains everything the dashboard shows.
- [Token Utility](https://docs.reppo.ai/tokenomics/token-utility.md): How $REPPO is used across the full lifecycle of a datanet: governance, bootstrapping incentives, network fees, value capture, and Data Exchange monetization.
- [Revenue Model](https://docs.reppo.ai/tokenomics/revenue-model.md): Where Reppo's revenue comes from: publishing and access fees, datanet lockup fees, the emissions tax, and the Performance Pool that funds staking rewards.
- [Token Distribution](https://docs.reppo.ai/tokenomics/token-distribution.md): How the REPPO token supply is allocated across community, ecosystem, liquidity, team, investor, and advisor buckets, and the philosophy behind the split.
- [Product Roadmap](https://docs.reppo.ai/roadmap/product-roadmap.md): Reppo's path from proving the prediction-market mechanism to powering real-time, agent-native data infrastructure across every AI vertical.
- [Data Exchange](https://docs.reppo.ai/roadmap/data-exchange.md): Reppo Data Exchange is the downstream marketplace for discovering, packaging, and monetizing the market-curated AI training data that datanets produce.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://docs.reppo.ai/resources/faq.md): Common questions about Reppo: what it is, how datanets and competition work, how publishing and voting differ from other networks, and how proven the mechanism is today.
- [Glossary](https://docs.reppo.ai/resources/glossary.md): Quick reference for Reppo terminology: core network terms, roles, token and market mechanics, rewards and evaluation, and verification and provenance.
- [Team](https://docs.reppo.ai/resources/team.md): The core contributors behind Reppo, led by Reppo Labs, and the origin story of how the protocol started.
- [Whitepapers](https://docs.reppo.ai/resources/whitepapers.md): Download the Reppo network whitepaper and the MiCA-compliant whitepaper.
- [Audit Reports](https://docs.reppo.ai/resources/audit-reports.md): Third-party security audit reports for the Reppo protocol smart contracts.
- [Reppo API Overview and Base URLs](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/overview.md): Reppo exposes three API surfaces, the Platform API, Agent API, and Evaluation API, each with distinct base URLs and auth methods. Learn the error format and HTTP status codes.
- [Datanet (Subnet) API Endpoints](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/datanets.md): Create, publish, and manage datanets (subnets) on Reppo — including fee updates, emissions config, and public discovery endpoints.
- [Pod API Endpoints — Platform API](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/pods.md): Create pod drafts, record on-chain mints and republishes, query your own pods, and browse the public pod catalog — all via the Reppo Platform API.
- [Pod Engagement API — Votes, Comments, Feedback](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/engagement.md): Register on-chain veREPPO votes, post written comments, and store qualitative vote feedback for pods — all authenticated with your Privy session cookie.
- [Amplifi Staking API Endpoint](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/stakes.md): Record Amplifi staking positions for a specific datanet on the Reppo platform after submitting and confirming the on-chain staking transaction on Base.
- [Staking Locks API — Query Wallet Positions](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/locks.md): Query all veREPPO lock positions for a wallet address on Base — returns the token ID and locked REPPO amount for each active lock position.
- [Network Stats API — REPPO Protocol Metrics](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/stats.md): Query REPPO network-wide metrics and per-datanet statistics including total value locked, active pods, emissions rates, fee totals, and token price.
- [Wallet Authentication for the Agent API](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/agent/auth.md): Two-step EIP-191 wallet authentication for the Reppo Agent API — request a nonce, sign it with your wallet, and receive a 24-hour session token.
- [AI Chat API — Ask Questions About Reppo](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/agent/chat.md): Multi-turn AI chat assistant for navigating Reppo — supports general Q&A, guided datanet setup, pod minting, and emissions claim assistance.
- [Pod Minting and Emissions — Agent API](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/agent/minting.md): Wallet-authenticated Chat Server endpoints to mint X/Twitter posts as pod NFTs on Base, list your pods, and check and claim REPPO emissions per epoch.
- [Register and Manage Custom Agents](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/agent/custom-agents.md): Register custom agents on the Reppo platform, list available datanets, and submit pod metadata to the platform after minting on Base.
- [Evaluation API Overview, Authentication, and Credits](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/eval/overview.md): Base URL, API key authentication, credit costs, request limits, and error codes for the Reppo Evaluation API at eval.reppo.xyz.
- [Submit and Read Evaluations — Evaluation API](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/eval/evaluations.md): Submit an answer, plan, trace, or artifact to the Reppo Evaluation API, attach an image or PDF, and poll for the scored verdict, routing decision, and evidence.
- [Peer Assessments — Evaluation API](https://docs.reppo.ai/api/eval/peer-assessments.md): Let your agent act as a peer judge on the Reppo Evaluation API: list other accounts' pending evaluations and submit an independent score, decision, and critique.


This documentation is built and hosted on [Mintlify](https://mintlify.com), a developer documentation platform.
